_comment: Words the way through the game needs: what writes an Age each early rare material grows in
(phasmium, rime crystal, temperstone, astrite, arc crystal), and the aiming page each is said to (Jonah,
2026-10-05). As often as the staples, and a bucket of their own so a loot table or a structure can ask
for them by name -- the lost library's shelf page is drawn from here. The window's words and the city's
are not here: those come from structures and the survey reports.
prefers_the_unknown: a page drawn for a finder (a chest they opened, the library's shelf page they took)
takes a critical word they have not learned while any are left, so no find is a duplicate until all are
known. `electromagnetic` is not here: it sets what `tempest` and `aurora` already do (Jonah, 2026-10-11).
once_all_known: a finder who has learned every critical word draws from the uncommon and rare buckets
instead, so the library's shelf page is still worth taking (Jonah, 2026-10-17).
